test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pipe A, B and C together can fill a tank in 9 minutes. Pipe B and C together can fill the same tank in 12 minutes. Pipe C and A together can fill the same tank in 18 minutes. In how much time (in minutes) pipe B alone can fill the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

A + B + C = 9 min

B + C = 12 min

C + A = 18 min

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of times

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

LCM of 9, 12, 18 = 36

⇒ Total work = 36 units
